handbookNote: Oregon Principal Broker license exam. Previously drafted (511 questions, 13 topic files) but left unwired pending real exam mechanics, since PSI's candidate portal for Oregon (test-takers.psiexams.com/orre) is JS-rendered and resisted every fetch attempt during the original R26 drafting pass. Unblocked 2026-09-03 by fetching PSI's real candidate bulletin PDF directly from its underlying content API (https://test-takers.psiexams.com/api/content/bulletin/3376, linked from the Oregon Real Estate Agency's own official broker-license page at oregon.gov/rea/licensing/get-license/Pages/broker.aspx) and extracting it with pdftotext. Exam vendor: PSI, under contract with the Oregon Real Estate Agency (REA). Oregon's real license tier naming: the entry-level license is itself called 'Broker' (not 'Salesperson' as in most other states -- this site's existing or_re_salesperson track represents that entry-level 'Broker' tier under the site's own cross-state normalized naming), and the supervisory tier -- this track -- is called 'Principal Broker'. Real, confirmed mechanics for the Principal Broker exam: National section 75 items (worth 80 points -- a real, distinctive Oregon/PSI quirk: 'National principal broker exams include questions that are scored up to two points', per the bulletin's own footnote) in 150 minutes; State section 50 items (50 points) in 90 minutes. Combined: 125 items, 240 minutes (4 hours) total. Passing score: 75% on EACH section separately (the bulletin states this explicitly: 'you must score 75% or better on both sections to successfully pass the entire exam' -- a candidate who passes only one section keeps that pass for 12 months while retaking the other). track_registry models this as exam_question_count=125, exam_duration_sec=14400, pass_percent=75, min_correct=94 (round(125*0.75)=93.75) -- a practice approximation against raw item count, since the real point-weighting (75 national items worth 80 points) isn't itself replicable in this site's simple correct-count scoring model, the same kind of scaled/point-based-score caveat already documented for CA Notary and Utah Broker. National portion topics per PSI's real content outline: Property Ownership, Encumbrances & Land Use Controls, Contracts/Agency/Disclosure, Financing & Settlement, Real Estate Calculations, Property Valuation & Appraisal, Practice of Real Estate & Fair Housing, Property Management & Leasing. Oregon state portion topics: Licensing Requirements, License Law & Disciplinary Measures (License Status), Handling of Clients' Funds & Recovery Fund (Trust Accounts), Regulation of Broker Activities (Disciplinary Actions), Agency Law & Rules and Oregon Real Estate Related Statutes (Agency & Disclosures). Pool ratio: 511 questions against a 125-item exam = 4.09:1, above the 4:1 hard floor.
